referenceLimitations: Padded or repeated-space text is not normalized by global search
Reopened search can return focus to an earlier element rather than the current opener; input autofocus and Tab containment are separate checks
Profile Save is in-memory only, Cancel restores the original fixture rather than the last saved values, and non-Profile tabs are placeholders
Photo selection does not change avatar or dirty state; Remove leaves the file in the native input; selecting a 1x1 PNG is not proof of upload or removal
The large profile email input has no accessible name
At 375px the 220px profile rail clips right-side fields and puts Save offscreen; geometry parity is not a usable mobile editor
Mock sidebar navigation changes highlighting while the content stays Orders; saved profile names do not update the fixed footer identity
